d: The Orange County Choppers crew is back in action, and there's plenty happening inside the workshop! Watch Paul Teutul Sr., Paul Jr., and the team take on fresh projects, tackle demanding fabrication work, and bring ambitious custom motorcycle designs to life. From creative decisions to workshop challenges, every build puts the crew's skills and teamwork to the test. Catch the excitement, craftsmanship, and behind-the-scenes drama of this motorcycle reality show. Watch American Chopper Season 2 Episodes 40, 41, 36, 35, 31, 33, 30 and 32 only on discovery+ India.
